title: Model-Residency SDI Architecture Spec

model_residency_sdi_definition.description: Subset of SDI focused on making dense models usable on constrained CPU/no-GPU hardware by reducing: (1) model memory residency, (2) per-token weight streaming, (3) KV/context growth, (4) dense activation waste
not: Prompt routing (doesn't compress single model memory)
Quantization only (reduces bits/param but not streaming pattern)
Speculative decoding only (reduces forward pass count not memory per pass)
PRT only (custom-op overlay path slower than native Q4_K_M)
model_residency_sdi_definition.specifically_addresses: The memory wall that quantization alone does not solve for dense models on constrained hardware

layer_1_memory_residency.purpose: Reduce or manage memory required for weights, KV cache, runtime buffers, sidecars, context
mechanisms: KV eviction — drop low-relevance tokens as context grows
KV compression — summarize older KV into smaller representation
Context summarization — reduce prompt redundancy before KV accumulation
Memory-aware context packing — limit active context based on available RAM
Quantization selection — Q4 vs Q5 vs Q8 based on memory budget
Model-size-aware routing — route to smaller model when memory is tight
Swap avoidance — detect pressure and throttle before OOM
Resident model management — keep only active components loaded
Compressed weight formats — beyond Q4 bits/param
Native-layout sidecars — arranged for CPU cache lines
Selective FFN/block execution — only relevant FFN blocks per token
Decoded weight caching — cache dequantized weights across tokens
Mixed-precision placement — hot in higher, cold in lower
layer_2_bandwidth_reduction.note: PRT demonstrated that custom-op overlay without layout optimization doesn't win bandwidth

layer_3_activation_reduction.purpose: Avoid activating unnecessary dense compute per token
mechanisms: Selective FFN — skip blocks/channels based on learned relevance
Early exit — stop forward pass at earlier layer for easy tokens
Token-dependent layer skipping — route tokens through relevant layers only
Attention sparsity — reduce attention to low-importance tokens
Dense fallback anchors — always have full-density fallback
layer_3_activation_reduction.quality_risk: HIGH — without trained sparsity mask and clean fallback, output degradation likely

layer_4_verification_correctness.purpose: Preserve output quality as primary constraint
mechanisms: Native fallback — full dense path always available
Speculative verification — verify speculative tokens against full model
Semantic canaries — detect quality drift via lightweight semantic check
Exact-match canaries — regression test against known-good outputs
Regression harnesses — automated quality tests before SDI deployment
Fallback thresholds — trigger fallback automatically on quality signal

layer_5_control_plane.purpose: Choose which SDI mechanism to use dynamically
mechanisms: Smart Agent Router — orchestrates all SDI mechanisms as policy engine
Prompt classifier — categorizes prompts to route to appropriate SDI path
Speculative routing — enable speculative decoding for code/structured prompts
Context budget policy — enforce context limits based on memory
Memory pressure monitor — detect swap/OOM risk before it happens
Model selector — choose model size based on prompt + memory
Local/cloud fallback — route to cloud when local memory constrained

bottleneck_to_mechanism_map.expected_payoff: enables larger models on current hardware

1_A_kv_compression.title: KV/Context Compression Probe
1_A_kv_compression.why: Highest urgency — 7B at 4K+ context is memory-stressed now. KV eviction is the only mechanism that prevents swap without changing model weights or kernel math. Low quality risk.
first_phase: Measure current KV growth vs context length
1_A_kv_compression.success_criteria: 7B at 8K runs without swap, <10% quality degradation on eval prompts

2_B_sdi_controller.title: SDI Controller v1
2_B_sdi_controller.why: Highest strategic value — router already exists, policy layer transforms it into intelligent control plane. Medium complexity, large payoff.
first_phase: Hook into speculative decoding as first SDI mechanism
2_B_sdi_controller.success_criteria: Router correctly routes code to speculative, long-context to KV-managed, memory-pressure to smaller model

3_C_specbenchcpu.title: SpecBenchCPU Revalidation
3_C_specbenchcpu.why: Lowest risk — already showed code speedups. Quick win but limited strategic value beyond confirming existing work.
first_phase: Record speculative vs native tokens/sec on code prompts
Validate output quality vs native baseline
Document as SDI speculative component baseline

4_D_residency_monitor.title: Model Residency Monitor
4_D_residency_monitor.why: Useful infrastructure but not a win itself — lower priority than mechanisms

5_E_prt_v3_design.title: PRT v3 Design Only
5_E_prt_v3_design.why: High complexity, no clear implementation path. 6-12 month effort with no near-term demo. Preserve as design doc only.

recommended_first_build.title: KV/Context Compression Probe
rationale: 7B at 4K+ context is most urgent near-term problem on current hardware
KV eviction is the only mechanism that solves swap risk without modifying model weights or kernel math
Quality risk lower than weight manipulation
Success is measurable (swap avoidance + quality eval)
Builds directly on VaultBrain/ContextOS work already in progress
recommended_first_build.demo_scenario: 7B Q4_K_M at 8K context — before: swap-bound ~3 tokens/sec. After: KV eviction enabled — runs without swap, maintains ~8-10 tokens/sec
recommended_first_build.what_it_is_not: A full SDI controller — just the first mechanism, implemented cleanly

success_criteria.quality: <10% degradation on eval prompts vs no-eviction baseline
success_criteria.kv_reduction_ratio: >=30% reduction in active KV at 4K+ context
success_criteria.integration: Can be called from Smart Agent Router policy layer

kill_criteria.quality: Any automated semantic canary fails on common prompts
kill_criteria.latency: Per-token decode time increases >50% vs no-eviction
kill_criteria.complexity: Requires more than 3 new config knobs
kill_criteria.integration: Cannot be triggered via Smart Agent Router policy
kill_criteria.real_prompts: Fails on real long-context prompts Matt actually uses

what_not_to_do_next: Full SDI controller as first build (scope creep — do KV probe first)
Long benchmark loops before KV probe is done
